entities.name: Joan of Arc
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: French peasant girl (c. 1412–1431) who claimed divine visions, led the French army to decisive victories in the Hundred Years' War, and was burned at the stake for heresy. Later canonized as a saint, she became a symbol of French national identity.
